words.definition: The study of the distribution and determinants of health-related events, diseases, or health-related characteristics among populations
words.definationTranslation: स्वास्थ्य संबंधी घटनाओं, रोगों या स्वास्थ्य संबंधी विशेषताओं के वितरण और निर्धारकों का अध्ययन

words.definition: The act of introducing a vaccine into the body to produce immunity to a specific disease

words.definition: The provision of medical services to individuals or communities

sentence.sentence: The government is working to improve the healthcare system to provide better services to its citizens.

words.definition: The act of stopping something from happening or reducing its impact

sentence.sentence: The public health policy focuses on prevention and early intervention to reduce the burden of diseases.

words.definition: A course of action or set of principles guiding decisions and actions

sentence.sentence: The government has introduced a new policy to promote public health and well-being.

words.definition: A sudden and significant increase in the occurrence of a disease or condition

words.definition: A disorder of structure or function in a human, animal, or plant, especially one that produces specific signs or symptoms

sentence.sentence: The disease has affected millions of people worldwide and has had a significant impact on global health.

words.definition: A state of complete physical, mental, and social well-being, and not merely the absence of disease or infirmity

words.definition: A relationship between two or more organizations or individuals working together to achieve a common goal
words.definationTranslation: दो या अधिक संगठनों या व्यक्तियों के बीच एक संबंध जो एक साझा लक्ष्य को प्राप्त करने के लिए एक साथ काम करते हैं

sentence.sentence: The partnership between the government and private sector has improved healthcare access and outcomes.
sentence.translation: सरकार और निजी क्षेत्र के बीच साझेदारी ने स्वास्थ्य देखभाल पहुंच और परिणामों में सुधार किया है।

sentence.sentence: The partnership is working to promote public health policies and programs that benefit marginalized communities.
sentence.translation: साझेदारी हाशिए के समुदायों को लाभ पहुंचाने वाली सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य नीतियों और कार्यक्रमों को बढ़ावा देने के लिए काम कर रही है।
